Proposition
[normal tensors and complex sectional curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0371 ↗ prop:pet-ch9-02tensor-hat-formula ↗ def:pet-ch9-complex-sectional-curvature 1. ch9:9.4.12If the endomorphism $H$ associated with a $(0,2)$-tensor $h$ is normal, then nonnegative complex sectional curvature implies $g(\mathfrak R(\hat h),\hat h)\ge 0$.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch9-normal-tensor-nonneg-complex-sectional \sketch Choose a complex orthonormal eigenbasis $H(e_i)=\lambda _ie_i$. By subsection 4.5,

\[ g(\mathfrak R(\hat h),\hat h) =\sum _{i,j}|\lambda _i-\bar\lambda _j|^2 g(\mathfrak R(e_i\wedge e_j),\bar e_i\wedge \bar e_j). \]

Every summand is nonnegative under the stated hypothesis.

□
